study.title: The effects of acupuncture treatment on the right frontoparietal network in migraine without aura patients
study.journal: The Journal of Headache and Pain
study.study_design: Longitudinal pre-post study with healthy control comparison; resting-state fMRI and DTI
study.population: Migraine without aura (MWoA) patients and healthy control (HC) subjects
study.inclusion_criteria: diagnosed of MWoA according to the classification criteria of the International Headache Society; between 18 and 60 years old; right-handed; 2 to 6 migraine attacks per month during the last 3 months; with a history of migraine longer than 1 year; without history of prophylactic or therapeutic medicine during the last 3 months; without history of acupuncture treatment; without history of smoking, alcohol or drug abuse; without history of long-term analgesics consumption; without history of dysmenorrhea or other chronic painful disease; with education background of more than 10 years; without any MRI contraindications; the informed consent form signed
study.exclusion_criteria: other types of migraine; the first occurrence of migraine attack appeared after 50 years old; concurrence of neurological disease or psychiatric disorder; with diseases of the cardiovascular system, liver, kidney, or hematopoietic system; pregnant or lactating women; participation in other clinical trials

conditions.timepoint_exact: before acupuncture treatment; within 3 days before treatment course began
after 4 weeks standard acupuncture treatment; within 3 days after treatment course ended

interventions.anatomical_location_exact: All acupoints were located according to the WHO standard acupuncture point locations in the Western Pacific Region
interventions.penetration_exact: inserted in an appropriate angle to a depth of 1.5-2.5 cm
interventions.manipulation_exact: Each acupuncture needle was twisted until the patient felt a de-qi sensation
interventions.deqi_intended_exact: yes; each acupuncture needle was twisted until the patient felt a de-qi sensation
interventions.number_of_sessions_exact: 5 times per week (from Monday to Friday) for 4 weeks
interventions.practitioner_description_exact: an independent practitioner with 7 years of clinical experience
interventions.participant_instructions_exact: all MWoA patients were told not to take any medication or preventive treatment during the whole study. In case of intolerable migraine attacks, patients could take analgesics they commonly used without the effect of migraine prevention and should record the doses and effects
interventions.treatment_rationale_given_exact: The acupuncture treatment course was established according to Chinese guidelines of acupuncture for migraine patients

sensory_interoceptive_responses.value_exact: All patients reported the sensation of de-qi
sensory_interoceptive_responses.notes: Only narrative statement that all patients reported de-qi; no quantitative scale used

neuroimaging_methods.sequence_exact: T2-weighted single-shot, gradient-recalled echo planar imaging sequence (functional); 3D MRI sequences (structural); single-shot, echo-planar imaging sequence (DTI)
neuroimaging_methods.voxel_size_exact: 1 mm3 (structural); 2 mm × 2 mm × 2 mm (resampled functional); slice thickness 1.5 mm (DTI)
neuroimaging_methods.analysis_software_exact: GIFT software (ICA); SPM8 (group-level analyses); FMRIB Software Library (FSL) and Analysis of Functional NeuroImage (AFNI) software (DTI); DTITK and DTI VISTA software (DTI processing); Brain Voyager QX (DTI visualization)
neuroimaging_methods.normalization_template_exact: MNI space; templates created by T1 images segmented by DARTEL method; IIT3 mean template image (DTI)
neuroimaging_methods.smoothing_exact: Gaussian kernel with a full width at half-maximum of 6 mm
neuroimaging_methods.motion_exclusion_exact: All subjects' had less than 1.5 mm head motions and less than 1.5° rotation in any direction
neuroimaging_methods.filtering_exact: spectrum of resting state networks was 0.01-0.08Hz; components not related to the spectrum of resting-state networks were removed
primary_neuroimaging_metrics: functional connectivity (FC) of the right frontoparietal network (RFPN) via independent component analysis (ICA)
statistical_thresholds_exact: two-tailed, p < 0.05, Monte Carlo Simulations correction, iterated 1000 times, cluster size > 349 voxels
neuroimaging_methods.multiple_comparison_correction_exact: Monte Carlo Simulations correction, iterated 1000 times, cluster size > 349 voxels

extraction_notes.note: No coordinate tables are provided in the paper. Brain regions showing altered FC are reported only as narrative text and visible in brain image figures (Figures 1 and 2). No peak MNI or Talairach coordinates are tabulated.
The paper states results are mapped in Talairach space, but no specific x, y, z coordinates are given for any reported cluster or peak. All coordinate fields are marked null.
No sham acupuncture or placebo control arm was included. The study lacks a control for natural course, placebo effects, or expectancy. Authors acknowledge this limitation explicitly.
Expectancy, credibility, and blinding were not assessed or reported. No relevant instruments were administered.

The paper does not report cluster sizes or t-statistics for individual regions in the neuroimaging results tables; only corrected threshold criteria (p < 0.05, Monte Carlo Simulations, cluster size > 349 voxels) are stated globally.

Figure captions in the PDF appear to be swapped or mislabeled: Figure 1 caption describes HC vs MWoA decreased FC result (which matches the brain images shown), while Figure 2 caption describes post- vs pre-treatment increased FC result. However, the figures in the results section text match the opposite caption (Figure 3 and Figure 4 labels in text appear to refer to correlation scatter plots). This is an internal inconsistency in the paper's figure numbering that could not be resolved from the PDF alone.

Figure 3 and Figure 4 in the main text appear to be correlation scatter plots (FC vs VAS), but the figure captions as written in the PDF describe neuroimaging brain maps. The actual scatter plot figures visible in the PDF are labeled as Figures 3 and 4 in the discussion section. This labeling inconsistency is preserved in extraction.

DTI data were acquired but no between-group comparison of DTI metrics (e.g., FA values) between MWoA and HC is reported. DTI was used only for tractography to support functional findings anatomically.

The number of sessions (20) is inferred from the stated treatment schedule (5 times per week for 4 weeks). This is explicitly stated in the paper: 'took place 5 times per week (from Monday to Friday) and lasted for 4 weeks.'
Trial registration number is not reported.
No PMID is provided in the document. The DOI (10.1186/s10194-015-0518-4) is reported in the paper header.
The study uses within-subject pre-post design for MWoA patients with a separate HC group for cross-sectional comparison only. The HC group did not receive any intervention and was scanned only once.
ICA component selection details (number of components, model order) are not reported beyond the goodness-of-fit matching to RFPN template.
